title: External HTTP/3 Peer Harness Work Item
summary: Add a repo-local advisory HTTP/3 peer harness with Docker Compose targets, Windows/POSIX scripts, JSONL result capture, and Markdown report generation.
planned_changes:
- Add a minimal Incursa HTTP/3 CLI client sample for compose-driven downloads.
- Make the sample HTTP/3 file server bind to a container-reachable address.
- Add Dockerfiles for Incursa client/server and an aioquic utility image.
- Add Docker Compose targets for Incursa, curl, aioquic, quiche/h3i, and ngtcp2/nghttp3 cells.
- Add PowerShell and Bash runner scripts that create fixtures, generate certificates, run wired cells, and record skip rows for unwired cells.
- Add a Python JSONL-to-Markdown result parser.
- Add checked-in documentation and a report template.
out_of_scope: claiming live pass status for every peer cell
does not promote broad HTTP/3 peer support
pinning every third-party HTTP/3 tool command in this first slice
changing HTTP/3 protocol behavior to make the matrix pass
verification_plan: Run solution build, run the requirement-home tests for REQ-QUIC-INT-0031, run the harness in plan-only mode, run the parser against the generated JSONL, and run core SpecTrace validation.
